2018 season inside a Cleveland courthouse, a system more than a single defendant.

How Serial Season 3 connects

  • Topic: Serial — Season 3 is Serial's Cleveland courthouse season.
  • Location: Cuyahoga County Justice Center — Season 3 is reported from the Cuyahoga County Justice Center.
  • Work: Serial Season 2 — Season 2 came before the Cleveland courthouse season.

What is Serial Season 3?

Season 3 plants Koenig and the team in the Justice Center in Cleveland, following ordinary dockets instead of one famous name — Serial's attempt to scale the form from a person to a courthouse.

Key threads lead to Serial, Cuyahoga County Justice Center and Serial Season 2.
